lore3143_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [deep gravelly sincerity, reserved warmth, wry at the end] I would be glad to have your company. There, you heard me. You have earned more than another task to carry away from the Den. Tell me where you would like to go, and I will try to leave a few of my warnings behind.
lore3143_befriended_1.ogg.text: I would be glad to have your company. There, you heard me. You have earned more than another task to carry away from the Den. Tell me where you would like to go, and I will try to leave a few of my warnings behind.

lore3143_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [gravelly blunt welcome, assessing, grudging friendly humor] Still in one piece? Good. Come here and tell me what you have been doing. I expect there is something worth hearing beneath all that dust. If you have done well, I might even say so without immediately finding another thing to warn you about.
lore3143_greet_1.ogg.text: Still in one piece? Good. Come here and tell me what you have been doing. I expect there is something worth hearing beneath all that dust. If you have done well, I might even say so without immediately finding another thing to warn you about.

lore3143_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [rough dry self-awareness, restrained amusement, gruff affection] Well done. That should be simple enough to say. Two words. Yet somehow I keep finding a warning to put after them. You may remind me to stop when I have already made my point. Once. Do not make a new habit of it.
lore3143_idle_1.ogg.text: Well done. That should be simple enough to say. Two words. Yet somehow I keep finding a warning to put after them. You may remind me to stop when I have already made my point. Once. Do not make a new habit of it.

lore3143_quest_1.ogg.spoken: [firm rough approval, deliberate sincere praise, quietly warm] You followed it through. Well done. I was about to add something about the next task, but that can wait. Let the work you finished have its moment. An honest effort deserves recognition, and you should not have to dig through three warnings to find it.
lore3143_quest_1.ogg.text: You followed it through. Well done. I was about to add something about the next task, but that can wait. Let the work you finished have its moment. An honest effort deserves recognition, and you should not have to dig through three warnings to find it.

lore3191_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [gruff sincere friendship, slightly embarrassed, warm dry humor] Fine, I'll come along. You've done more than turn up hungry and disappear when there's work to be done. I like having you around. There, said it. You needn't stand looking surprised until dinner. Come on, we'll find somewhere to stop when it's time to eat.
lore3191_befriended_1.ogg.text: Fine, I'll come along. You've done more than turn up hungry and disappear when there's work to be done. I like having you around. There, said it. You needn't stand looking surprised until dinner. Come on, we'll find somewhere to stop when it's time to eat.

lore3191_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [gruff practical welcome, brisk concern, dry warmth] All right, let's go. If you've skipped a meal to get here, say so now. I don't want to hear about your great plans while your stomach argues louder than you do. A little food and some sense will carry you farther than pretending you need neither of them.
lore3191_greet_1.ogg.text: All right, let's go. If you've skipped a meal to get here, say so now. I don't want to hear about your great plans while your stomach argues louder than you do. A little food and some sense will carry you farther than pretending you need neither of them.

lore3191_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [blunt guarded hope, matter-of-fact, faintly defensive affection] Those seeds are for planting. Not rubbish, not a decoration, and not something I put aside because I enjoy making more work for myself. The troops get enough meat and fish. I'd like to see something sweet growing closer to hand. There's nothing complicated about wanting that.
lore3191_idle_1.ogg.text: Those seeds are for planting. Not rubbish, not a decoration, and not something I put aside because I enjoy making more work for myself. The troops get enough meat and fish. I'd like to see something sweet growing closer to hand. There's nothing complicated about wanting that.

lore3191_quest_1.ogg.spoken: [brisk practical approval, firm instruction, restrained warmth] Good. Useful work finished, and something to show for it. That's worth more than a fine account of what you nearly did. Now put what you've brought somewhere it won't be crushed, scattered, or stepped on. The last bit of care still matters when you're almost done.
lore3191_quest_1.ogg.text: Good. Useful work finished, and something to show for it. That's worth more than a fine account of what you nearly did. Now put what you've brought somewhere it won't be crushed, scattered, or stepped on. The last bit of care still matters when you're almost done.

lore3310_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [deep gravelly voice, warmly sincere] You're more than a fare and a destination to me, friend.
lore3310_befriended_1.ogg.text: You're more than a fare and a destination to me, friend.

lore3310_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [deep gravelly voice, welcoming confidence] Ready? There's a whole world beyond the edge of that tower.
lore3310_greet_1.ogg.text: Ready? There's a whole world beyond the edge of that tower.

lore3310_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [low resonant voice, quietly pleased] Some riders count the coins. I watch for the smile when they come back.
lore3310_idle_1.ogg.text: Some riders count the coins. I watch for the smile when they come back.

lore3310_taxi_1.ogg.spoken: [steady reassuring voice, growing wonder] Hands steady. Pack secure. Now look out there... that's yours to see.
lore3310_taxi_1.ogg.text: Hands steady. Pack secure. Now look out there... that's yours to see.

lore3317_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [steady] [sincere] You have learned when to speak and when to let a quiet moment stay quiet. I value that. Walk beside me. You need not find something useful to say just to earn your place there.
lore3317_befriended_1.ogg.text: You have learned when to speak and when to let a quiet moment stay quiet. I value that. Walk beside me. You need not find something useful to say just to earn your place there.

lore3317_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [gruff] [friendly] Ready to go? Make sure you can move your shoulders properly. A fine-looking outfit is little use if it fights you at every step. There. Much better. Let us see where the road takes us.
lore3317_greet_1.ogg.text: Ready to go? Make sure you can move your shoulders properly. A fine-looking outfit is little use if it fights you at every step. There. Much better. Let us see where the road takes us.

lore3317_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [low] [gently amused] A cat once fell asleep on a shirt I meant to sell. I could have moved it. Instead, I found another shirt. A little purring was doing more for the afternoon than another hurried sale.
lore3317_idle_1.ogg.text: A cat once fell asleep on a shirt I meant to sell. I could have moved it. Instead, I found another shirt. A little purring was doing more for the afternoon than another hurried sale.

lore3317_loot_1.ogg.spoken: [practical] [dryly amused] Wrap the hard edges before you put that among the cloth. A little care now saves a great deal of cursing later. I have heard enough arguments with torn sleeves to know how those end.
lore3317_loot_1.ogg.text: Wrap the hard edges before you put that among the cloth. A little care now saves a great deal of cursing later. I have heard enough arguments with torn sleeves to know how those end.

lore3347_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [gruff] [warm] [wry] I enjoy your company. There. Said it before I could add a correction. Come along, friend. If you keep walking, I might manage another compliment before we get back.
lore3347_befriended_1.ogg.text: I enjoy your company. There. Said it before I could add a correction. Come along, friend. If you keep walking, I might manage another compliment before we get back.

lore3347_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [gruff] [dryly amused] You again. Good. I could use a walk before someone asks whether a rarer herb would improve the mixture. First I would like them to try measuring the ordinary one.
lore3347_greet_1.ogg.text: You again. Good. I could use a walk before someone asks whether a rarer herb would improve the mixture. First I would like them to try measuring the ordinary one.

lore3347_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [gruff] [reflective] Whuut has talent. I will say that much. Getting him to slow down long enough to use it properly is another matter. Still, I would rather teach someone who wants to learn everything.
lore3347_idle_1.ogg.text: Whuut has talent. I will say that much. Getting him to slow down long enough to use it properly is another matter. Still, I would rather teach someone who wants to learn everything.

lore3347_learned_1.ogg.spoken: [confident] [instructive] Speargrass and cattail. Nothing exotic. Whuut could hardly believe what a careful hand made from them. Remember that when someone tells you the secret must be an expensive ingredient.
lore3347_learned_1.ogg.text: Speargrass and cattail. Nothing exotic. Whuut could hardly believe what a careful hand made from them. Remember that when someone tells you the secret must be an expensive ingredient.

lore3389_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [firm] [sincere] You have earned my trust. I do not say that merely to give you another task. Today I would be glad of your company, even if we find nothing worth putting in a report.
lore3389_befriended_1.ogg.text: You have earned my trust. I do not say that merely to give you another task. Today I would be glad of your company, even if we find nothing worth putting in a report.

lore3389_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [steady] [warm] Good. I know I can count on you to pay attention. Walk with me, and keep an eye on the ground as well as the road. There is a small column I would rather not disturb.
lore3389_greet_1.ogg.text: Good. I know I can count on you to pay attention. Walk with me, and keep an eye on the ground as well as the road. There is a small column I would rather not disturb.

lore3389_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [dryly amused] [reflective] An ant found a stone in its path. Went around it. The rest followed without a single argument. I watched for longer than I intended. No, there is no inspection report about it.
lore3389_idle_1.ogg.text: An ant found a stone in its path. Went around it. The rest followed without a single argument. I watched for longer than I intended. No, there is no inspection report about it.

lore3389_quest_1.ogg.spoken: [measured] [approving] You did well. Tell me what happened while the details are clear. Courage matters, but so does giving the next person enough knowledge to stand where you stood and do the work properly.
lore3389_quest_1.ogg.text: You did well. Tell me what happened while the details are clear. Courage matters, but so does giving the next person enough knowledge to stand where you stood and do the work properly.

lore3432_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere] [quiet emotion] You have given me more than help with another task. You have stayed. I do not know how to repay that, but I would be glad to walk beside you as a friend.
lore3432_befriended_1.ogg.text: You have given me more than help with another task. You have stayed. I do not know how to repay that, but I would be glad to walk beside you as a friend.

lore3432_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [low] [restrained warmth] You came back. I am glad. We can walk for a while if you wish. I may not have much to say, but I would welcome your company.
lore3432_greet_1.ogg.text: You came back. I am glad. We can walk for a while if you wish. I may not have much to say, but I would welcome your company.

lore3432_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [solemn] [steady] Her name is Olgra. I want that remembered when people speak of what happened. She was more than the loss that brought me to the Crossroads.
lore3432_idle_1.ogg.text: Her name is Olgra. I want that remembered when people speak of what happened. She was more than the loss that brought me to the Crossroads.

lore3432_rest_1.ogg.spoken: [weary] [gentle] We can stop here. There need not be a speech, or another promise made before we go on. Stay a little while, my friend. That is enough to ask for now.
lore3432_rest_1.ogg.text: We can stop here. There need not be a speech, or another promise made before we go on. Stay a little while, my friend. That is enough to ask for now.

lore3449_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [gruff] [warm] You keep turning up without needing another assignment. I like that. Come, friend. Give me a little news that belongs to you, before someone brings us another list of things to do.
lore3449_befriended_1.ogg.text: You keep turning up without needing another assignment. I like that. Come, friend. Give me a little news that belongs to you, before someone brings us another list of things to do.

lore3449_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [wry] [brisk] There you are. Come along. I have heard enough useful news today. Tell me something that made you grin, and try not to start with the number of supplies we are missing.
lore3449_greet_1.ogg.text: There you are. Come along. I have heard enough useful news today. Tell me something that made you grin, and try not to start with the number of supplies we are missing.

lore3449_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [dryly amused] [reflective] I ought to ask Jin'Zil for an ordinary bit of news. A bad joke would do. Something completely useless, just to know he still remembers how to make me regret asking for a story.
lore3449_idle_1.ogg.text: I ought to ask Jin'Zil for an ordinary bit of news. A bad joke would do. Something completely useless, just to know he still remembers how to make me regret asking for a story.

lore3449_quest_1.ogg.spoken: [confident] [matter-of-fact] Good work. Tell it plainly. If somebody else did the dangerous part, give them the credit. A useful account names the right person, even when the story would sound better with your name in it.
lore3449_quest_1.ogg.text: Good work. Tell it plainly. If somebody else did the dangerous part, give them the credit. A useful account names the right person, even when the story would sound better with your name in it.

lore3615_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [hearty sincere friendship, open pleasure, calm affectionate confidence] Gladly. You have become someone I look forward to seeing, even when you arrive with no bundle to send and no flight to catch. That seems a fine reason to spend some time together. Let us take a walk, my friend. We can decide where it is going after we have begun enjoying the company.
lore3615_befriended_1.ogg.text: Gladly. You have become someone I look forward to seeing, even when you arrive with no bundle to send and no flight to catch. That seems a fine reason to spend some time together. Let us take a walk, my friend. We can decide where it is going after we have begun enjoying the company.

lore3615_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [assured practical welcome, relaxed good humor, warm confidence] There you are. Are we going somewhere in particular, or shall we enjoy a little walk? I spend enough time helping people get where they need to be. It is pleasant to have company without an urgent delivery waiting at the far end. Tell me what you have in mind, and we can get moving.
lore3615_greet_1.ogg.text: There you are. Are we going somewhere in particular, or shall we enjoy a little walk? I spend enough time helping people get where they need to be. It is pleasant to have company without an urgent delivery waiting at the far end. Tell me what you have in mind, and we can get moving.

lore3615_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [easy confident pride, unhurried amusement, relaxed and sociable] My wind riders can make good time through this heat. I am quite proud of that. But when the work is finished, I enjoy taking a walk at my own pace. Sometimes I stop longer than I intended. That is part of the pleasure when nobody is waiting for me to deliver something.
lore3615_idle_1.ogg.text: My wind riders can make good time through this heat. I am quite proud of that. But when the work is finished, I enjoy taking a walk at my own pace. Sometimes I stop longer than I intended. That is part of the pleasure when nobody is waiting for me to deliver something.

lore3615_taxi_1.ogg.spoken: [clear experienced instruction, reassuring confidence, brisk friendly care] Before you settle in, make certain everything you are carrying is secure. A little care now makes the journey easier to enjoy. And when you arrive somewhere new, remember to meet its wind rider master. Knowing where you can return is a useful part of knowing where you have been.
lore3615_taxi_1.ogg.text: Before you settle in, make certain everything you are carrying is secure. A little care now makes the journey easier to enjoy. And when you arrive somewhere new, remember to meet its wind rider master. Knowing where you can return is a useful part of knowing where you have been.

lore4047_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [warm] [sincere] I value your company. With you, I can ask an ordinary question and receive an ordinary answer. That is a greater kindness than you may realize. Come, let us see where today leads.
lore4047_befriended_1.ogg.text: I value your company. With you, I can ask an ordinary question and receive an ordinary answer. That is a greater kindness than you may realize. Come, let us see where today leads.

lore4047_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [warm] [unhurried] There you are. Shall we walk? You may choose the direction. If you have something pleasant planned, there is no need to explain it. I would enjoy finding out along the way.
lore4047_greet_1.ogg.text: There you are. Shall we walk? You may choose the direction. If you have something pleasant planned, there is no need to explain it. I would enjoy finding out along the way.

lore4047_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [dryly amused] [reflective] A visitor once took every question I asked as proof that I knew the answer. We had a very long conversation, and I learned almost nothing about what he wanted.
lore4047_idle_1.ogg.text: A visitor once took every question I asked as proof that I knew the answer. We had a very long conversation, and I learned almost nothing about what he wanted.

lore4047_quest_1.ogg.spoken: [measured] [thoughtful] Tell me what you know, and what remains uncertain. We can be grateful for good work without pretending every mystery is settled. Some answers will require more time and more careful eyes.
lore4047_quest_1.ogg.text: Tell me what you know, and what remains uncertain. We can be grateful for good work without pretending every mystery is settled. Some answers will require more time and more careful eyes.

lore6928_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [hearty sincere friendship, openly pleased, confident warmth] Gladly. We have shared enough talk that I should like to share some of the road as well. You have become good company to me, and that is worth making time for. No, you need not earn another welcome before you ask. You are my friend. Come on, let us see what story we bring home together.
lore6928_befriended_1.ogg.text: Gladly. We have shared enough talk that I should like to share some of the road as well. You have become good company to me, and that is worth making time for. No, you need not earn another welcome before you ask. You are my friend. Come on, let us see what story we bring home together.

lore6928_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [hearty hospitable welcome, brisk good humor, practical concern] There you are. Ready for a walk, or have you been running since dawn and calling that preparation? Tell me before we set out. I like a fine adventure as much as the next orc, but I prefer my companions with enough strength left to enjoy coming home. We can begin with a drink if you need one.
lore6928_greet_1.ogg.text: There you are. Ready for a walk, or have you been running since dawn and calling that preparation? Tell me before we set out. I like a fine adventure as much as the next orc, but I prefer my companions with enough strength left to enjoy coming home. We can begin with a drink if you need one.

lore6928_hearth_1.ogg.spoken: [warm relieved homecoming, grounded affection, hearty sincerity] Back again. Good. Put your burdens down before you start describing how heavy they were. There is time to hear what happened, and time to let the road leave your shoulders. To your safe return, then. It may be an ordinary toast, but I would rather have you here to hear it than invent a grander one without you.
lore6928_hearth_1.ogg.text: Back again. Good. Put your burdens down before you start describing how heavy they were. There is time to hear what happened, and time to let the road leave your shoulders. To your safe return, then. It may be an ordinary toast, but I would rather have you here to hear it than invent a grander one without you.

lore6928_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [mock-ceremonial flourish, hearty dry humor, cheerful self-awareness] To the putting away of supplies, without which every grand victory would end in an argument about where the food went. No? Too long? I am still working on that one. It deserves a little dignity. People notice a warrior at the gate, but they certainly notice when the shelves behind him are empty.
lore6928_idle_1.ogg.text: To the putting away of supplies, without which every grand victory would end in an argument about where the food went. No? Too long? I am still working on that one. It deserves a little dignity. People notice a warrior at the gate, but they certainly notice when the shelves behind him are empty.
